integrity: The proof starts from the exact Alexander-polynomial and Cayley-transform formulas printed in the cited source, proves positivity on the positive real axis by a uniform inequality, and proves uniqueness on the negative axis by an exact hyperbolic-function factorization and strict monotonicity. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the real zeros of the displayed Alexander polynomial. It does not classify nonreal zeros or give a new sliceness obstruction.
title: Exactly two real Alexander roots in Lecuona's exceptional pretzel family
